meanings.note: High-frequency Russian pronominal determiner meaning 'what; what a', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: А тебе какое дело до этого?
examples.trans: And what business is that of yours?

examples.text: Вчера как-то неудобно у нас получилось.
examples.trans: Things turned out rather awkwardly between us yesterday.

examples.text: Как же они меня все достали!
examples.trans: How sick and tired I am of all of them!

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian expressive spoken interjection meaning 'Lord', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Господи, какой же ты всё-таки жалкий!
examples.trans: Good Lord, how pathetic you really are!

examples.text: Господи, что случилось?
examples.trans: Good Lord, what happened?

examples.text: Ах, господи!
examples.trans: Oh, Lord!

meanings.en: after all, still, all the same
meanings.note: Prefix 'вс-' ('up') marks upward or sudden onset of action (stem 'ё-таки').

examples.text: Господи, какой же ты всё-таки жалкий!
examples.trans: Good Lord, how pathetic you really are!

examples.text: Он всё-таки пришёл.
examples.trans: He came after all.

examples.text: Может, всё-таки пойдём?
examples.trans: Maybe we'll go after all?

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('pathetic / pitiful').

examples.text: Господи, какой же ты всё-таки жалкий!
examples.trans: Good Lord, how pathetic you really are!

examples.text: Это были жалкие попытки.
examples.trans: Those were pathetic attempts.

examples.text: Посмотрим на твои жалкие умения.
examples.trans: We will see your pathetic skills.

meanings.note: Prefix 'под-' ('under, up to') indicates approaching or supporting from below (stem 'ождать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'wait', paired with 'ждать'.

examples.text: Подожди, я сейчас.
examples.trans: Wait, I'll be right there.

examples.text: Подождите минуту.
examples.trans: Wait a minute.

examples.text: Подожди, Нин, ты не поняла. Это же стыдно!
examples.trans: Wait, Nina, you don't get it. It's shameful!

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'слушать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'listen', paired with 'слушать'.

examples.text: Катя, подожди, послушай меня!
examples.trans: Katya, wait, listen to me!

examples.text: Алло, Катя, только не бросай трубку, послушай.
examples.trans: Hello, Katya, just do not hang up, listen to me.

examples.text: Послушай, это важно.
examples.trans: Listen, this is important.
